items.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004
items.q: [(note)] Béla was interviewed before a performance at Hamilton in Clinton on December 7, 2004 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Béla Fleck was born in New York City on July 10, 1958. He has transformed the traditional role of the banjo while creating his own distinctive musical genre with the Flecktones. Béla has enjoyed musical collaborations with artists such as Bruce Hornsby, Chic Corea and Branford Marsalis, and he has received multiple Grammy awards for his recordings and compositions.
Béla was interviewed before a performance at Hamilton in Clinton on December 7, 2004 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
We are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive on campus and I’m really pleased to have Béla Fleck with me today. Welcome.
